faq.question: How is CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend tested for purity and identity?
faq.answer: Each lot of CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend is analysed by HPLC for purity and by mass spectrometry for identity. The lot-specific certificate of analysis reports the measured purity, retention time, molecular mass and appearance. Catalogue purity is stated at ≥99.0% (HPLC).

faq.question: How should CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend be stored?
faq.answer: Store the lyophilized powder at -20 °C, protected from light and moisture. After reconstitution, keep the solution at 2-8 °C and use it within the period stated in the lot certificate of analysis. Avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles. This product is for laboratory research use only.

faq.answer: CJC-1295 (No DAC) + Ipamorelin Blend is available in 2 configurations: 10 mg, 20 mg. Each kit contains 10 vials. Minimum order quantity is 1 kit. Volume pricing applies to 10-49 kits and 50+ kits.
